hook: Two million booby-trapped prompts exposed AI's leaky pipes

beats.say: Researcher HD Moore sent nearly two million AI prompts, each seeded with a unique fake secret, through AI routers and resellers, then watched where the secrets surfaced.
Attackers inside three AI providers stole requests, including some marked zero data retention. The bait AWS keys were used tens of thousands of times.
Some cheap resellers logged prompts themselves, and some providers scraped secret links from prompts, despite privacy terms.
